slides.title: Pricing your Laval home? Drop these 4 myths.
slides.sub: Real numbers from Sainte-Rose and Duvernay.

photo.credit: Église Sainte-Rose-de-Lima, Laval · Photo: Pierre5018, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons

slides.title: “My tax assessment is my price.”
slides.body: Laval's **2025–2027** assessment roll reflects market conditions as of **July 1, 2023**. Buyers pay today's prices.

slides.title: “The sector median is my price.”
slides.body: A median mixes every size and age. Compare homes like yours: same type, size and street.

slides.title: “Listings show what it’s worth.”

photo.credit: Parc de la Fabrique-Sainte-Rose, Laval · Photo: Jeangagnon, CC BY-SA 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons

slides.body: Sainte-Rose had **100** houses for sale and **71** sales in Q3. Asking prices are hopes. Solds are proof.

slides.title: “Price high, drop it later.”

photo.credit: Centre de la nature, Duvernay, Laval · Photo: Richard Mc Neil, CC BY 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons

slides.body: Duvernay houses sold in **27 days** on average in Q3. Start near recent solds, not above them.
